name: Blog
summary: A multilingual blog with SEO built in: an address per language, hreflang, structured data, RSS and a blog sitemap.
description:
Every post can have its own version and address in each language: /blog/... for the default language and /{language}/blog/... for the others. There are category, author and tag pages, and an RSS feed per language.

SEO: title, description and canonical, hreflang with x-default, Open Graph and Twitter cards, JSON-LD (BlogPosting, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, author profile) and a sitemap at /sitemap-blog.xml. A post can open with a short answer box and close with an FAQ, and an llms.txt file is served. With an IndexNow key, published posts are reported to Bing and Yandex.

Staff write in a rich text editor (Quill, bundled, no CDN), upload images, see a search result preview and schedule posts. HTML from the editor passes an allow list when it is saved.

name: Notifications
summary: A notification bell, a notifications page and recent activity in the client area, built from the emails PNLCS already sends.
description:
PNLCS emails its customers but has no notifications inside the client area. This addon turns each email sent to a customer into a notification that links to the invoice, service, domain or ticket it is about. All 28 customer emails of PNLCS are mapped; a new kind of email falls back to a general entry.

Only emails to the account itself count: copies to staff, verification codes and mass mail are skipped. Texts are produced in the reader's language when shown (English and Turkish), and account users only see the kinds their permissions allow. Entries older than 180 days are removed daily (this needs the Laravel scheduler cron).

The bell and the recent activity list are drawn by the theme. A theme without them still gets the notifications page.

name: Banners
summary: Campaign and announcement strips at the top of the client area overview, targeted by product, with view and click counts.
description:
Staff write banners with a title, text, button, optional image, tone (info, campaign or warning), start and end dates and order, and choose whether customers may dismiss them.

The audience is all customers, customers with an active service of chosen products, or customers without them, for cross-selling. Every view and button click is counted and the list shows the click rate. A dismissed banner is not shown to that account again.

PNLCS has no hook on the client home page yet, so the theme draws the banners. A ready-made strip view is included; another theme needs one line in its home page to show it.

name: Support PIN
summary: A daily six-digit PIN that customers read out on the phone, so staff can check that a caller really owns the account.
description:
The PIN changes every day at midnight and is derived from a secret key, so there is no table and no cron job. Customers with profile access see it in the client area and can renew it at once. Staff never see it.

Staff enter the client number or email and the PIN the caller reads out, and get correct or wrong. Every attempt is written to the customer's activity log with the staff member's name, and attempts are rate limited. Checking needs the view_clients permission.

Every theme gets the client page at /client/support-pin; a theme can also show the PIN in its own account menu.

name: System Pages
summary: Write the text of the 404, 403, 419, 429 and 500 error pages for each language from the admin panel, with a preview.
description:
Each page has a title, text, up to two buttons and a list of links, in every language the shop uses. An empty field falls back to the PNLCS text in that language, so a visitor never sees another language.

The texts are cached when saved, so the 500 page still opens when the database is down. Links accept only paths on the site and http(s) addresses.

While the addon is active, the active theme's own error pages are used (PNLCS otherwise ignores them), and a plain built-in design covers themes without error pages.

name: Admin Tools
summary: Quick notes tied to admin pages, and team to-dos with assignees and due dates, for PNLCS staff.
description:
Quick notes are private or shared with the team and belong to the admin page they were written on: go back to that page and the note is there. Notes can be pinned; only the author can delete them.

Team to-dos have a title, description, assignee, due date and related page. The assignee or the author completes or reopens them, and the number of tasks assigned to you and of overdue tasks is available to the theme's top bar.

It works next to the built-in to-do list and does not replace it. Every staff member can use it, and the addon page works in any theme.

name: PayTR
summary: Card payments through PayTR, instalments included, confirmed server to server, with refunds from PNLCS.
description:
Customers pay in the PayTR frame on the invoice. A payment is recorded only when PayTR's server-to-server notification arrives and its HMAC signature checks out; a repeated notification is recorded once. Failed payments, test payments on a live module and other currencies are logged, not recorded.

The invoice is credited with the amount asked for; an instalment surcharge paid by the customer is not added to it. Full and partial refunds go through PayTR's refund API from the PNLCS refund button.

Currencies: TRY, EUR, USD, GBP and RUB. Stored cards and automatic charging are not supported yet. Settings: merchant ID, key and salt, test mode and the highest number of instalments.

name: NetGSM SMS
summary: Sends PNLCS phone verification codes and other text messages through NetGSM, with a test message button.
description:
It plugs into the SMS provider contract of PNLCS, so verification codes go out through NetGSM once the settings are complete. If Twilio Verify is also set up, Twilio is used first.

Settings: NetGSM subscriber number, API password and an approved sender name. A test button sends a message to your own number. Messages with Turkish letters are sent with Turkish encoding, and NetGSM error codes are shown in plain words.

Turkish mobile numbers only. Sending is rate limited by PNLCS, and the test button by the addon.
